title: Lemony Spanish Tofu Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with marinated tofu, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Spanish flavors.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the tofu to the marinade and mix well.
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked tofu, crispy lettuce, and chopped cilantro on it.
Drizzle with extra lemon juice, if desired.
